The moment you understand that nobody is coming to save you, your bank account will finally start growing.

Ownership is the only cure for victimhood.

Fun fact: Ignorance debt collects interest every day you choose comfort over competence.

By May 2026, the gap between you and the outlier will be an abyss.

If you’re not tracking your outputs, consider checking your schedule before blaming your luck.

Average is a choice you make every morning.
